issues.description: Method singFarmSongVerse: the template declares singFarmSongVerse without an Animal parameter (signature: private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)) while the problem statement UML defines singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void and the reference solution declares singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) (protected). This mismatch of the parameter list between the template and the specification/solution will force students to change an existing helper method signature and may confuse them about the intended parameter to use when printing a verse for a given Animal.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Farm.java method signature to include the Animal parameter so it matches the UML and the solution (for example: private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) { ... }). Ensure the method body uses the provided animal parameter (e.g., animal.getClass().getSimpleName(), animal.messageOnFeed()) and adjust visibility if you prefer to match the solution (protected) but keep the parameter list consistent with the specification.
